text.content:
The Lady of Westbrook.

Role: Fixer
Location: A pachinko parlor on Jig-Jig Street, Japantown
Known for: Every kind of gig; respected, or at least feared, in Japantown

Wakako runs her business out of a pachinko parlor in Japantown. Her gigs cover every kind of work, and she was one of the few to keep helping Papa Sunrise's children after he vanished.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.27
